summary: IMPLEMENTED dev_supervisor/acceptance.py: a 13-step scripted autonomy scenario in a fresh temp state dir and temp git repository (two eligible tasks, one blocked; autonomy next; worker via lifecycle.Supervisor with a fake launcher or one bounded real `claude -p --model haiku --allowedTools Write` run in a cleaned environment; REPORTED then VERIFIED by reading the output file back; task COMPLETED then second task selected; synthetic transcript at 0.93 context ratio, compaction defers then allows after a verified handoff; replacement with fake launcher/heartbeat; replacement Main sees only the second task; Stop hook blocks then allows). Report lists each step with PASS/FAIL, REAL/SIMULATED/MOCKED and timings. TESTED: 40 offline tests (every failure injection fails exactly its step, isolation checks, report shape). OBSERVED: one default-mode run and one --real-worker run, both 13/13 PASS (real run: haiku exit 0, 10 stream lines, 1 result event, 0 errors). NOT TESTED: other models, Linux/macOS, interactive Main, real Resolve. Harness result on synthetic data is not a VERIFIED claim about the project.
